subject: Co-sell marketplace demo with Kairos / SAP integration — scheduling & ops
messages:
From: Amrita Shah <amrita@kairos-systems.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Rosenberg <ben@orchestrate.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Marketplace co-sell demo (SAP connector) — initial availability

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the intro, Ben. Kairos is excited to get a marketplace co-sell demo scheduled that shows our SAP-to-Redwood pipeline and how it will appear in the AWS Marketplace listing. We want to include a short technical walkthrough aimed at our SI partners (CloudWave) and a business-facing segment for procurement.

High-level asks:
- 30–40 minute joint demo (20 tech / 10 biz / 10 Q&A)
- Include CloudWave SI for implementation questions
- Prefer a Europe-friendly time window (our team is in London/Frankfurt)

Possible slots (all BST):
- Tue Apr 16, 10:00–10:40
- Wed Apr 17, 14:30–15:10
- Thu Apr 18, 09:00–09:40

Ben has suggested Redwood’s marketplace listing team join for the procurement walk-through; I copied him as well. We also have a short preflight checklist I can send if helpful.

Cheers,
Amrita Shah
Head of Partnerships, Kairos Systems
amrita@kairos-systems.com
[Attachment stub: Kairos-Requirements-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Amrita Shah <amrita@kairos-systems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Rosenberg <ben@orchestrate.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo (SAP connector) — initial availability

Thanks Amrita — really appreciate the clear slots.

Quick notes from our side:
- We can run the 40-minute format you proposed. Suggest 25 tech / 10 biz / 5 mins for next steps to keep momentum.
- Vanessa (partner ops) will coordinate invites and CloudWave logistics. Vanessa — can you reach out to CloudWave and confirm their lead engineer?
- Karthik (cc’d on follow-up) should handle the technical preflight; I’ll ask him for a short runbook + resource list.

Two things for planning:
1) Please share the preflight checklist you mentioned (attachments are helpful).
2) Do you need us to demo a specific cloud (AWS vs GCP) or both? We can pin an AWS Marketplace flow and call out the multi-cloud notes verbally.

Tentative preference from Redwood: Wed Apr 17, 14:30 BST — that aligns with our EU team and CloudWave’s APAC overlap. Can you confirm?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Cc: Ben Rosenberg <ben@orchestrate.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 12:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo (SAP connector) — initial availability

Hi Amrita / Kimberly —

I’ll take point on scheduling and CloudWave coordination. I pinged CloudWave (si@cloudwave.com) and asked for their lead engineer’s availability; they replied with two possible engineers (Lena / Arjun).

Proposed plan:
- Dry run with CloudWave + Karthik on Tue Apr 16 at 09:00 BST (30 min) — technical checklist only.
- Customer-facing demo on Wed Apr 17 at 14:30 BST — 40 minutes as proposed.

Amrita — can you confirm CloudWave is OK to join the dry run? If yes, I’ll send calendar invites and include the runbook and Kairos preflight checklist.

Attachments I’ll include on the invites:
- Redwood-Runbook-v2.pdf (overview of expected network ports, test accounts, model pin)
- Kairos-Preflight-Checklist.xlsx (you mentioned one; please confirm final version)

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots for 24 hours.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
[Attachment stub: Redwood-Runbook-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amrita Shah <amrita@kairos-systems.com>, CloudWave SI <si@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Marketplace co-sell demo (SAP connector) — initial availability

Thanks Vanessa — I can do the dry run (Tue Apr 16, 09:00 BST) and the demo slot (Wed Apr 17, 14:30 BST). A couple of operational asks from the tech side before the dry run:

1) Test account credentials or an ephemeral API key for Kairos test tenant (read-only demo scope).
2) Confirm model + quantization profile we should show (pin to raven-3b-q4 or show both raven-3b and raven-3b-q4?). If bandwidth is limited, we should demo the quantized variant to match Dedicated config.
3) Network: ensure port 443 outbound allowed for calls to Redwood hosted endpoints and that CloudWave has the connector's IP ranges whitelisted (I’ll share ranges in a separate note).

I’ve attached a short runbook excerpt I’ll use in the dry run. I’ll also bring a troubleshooting checklist for common DKIM/CORS issues in case the SAP demo requires iframes or direct SSO flows.

Attachment stubs: [Redwood-Runbook-v2.pdf (pdf)], [Runbook-Excerpt-Karthik.txt (txt)]

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Tech Ops — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Thanks team — confirm final plan below and I’ll send the calendar invites from Redwood’s marketplace account.

Final schedule:
- Dry run (internal + CloudWave): Tue Apr 16, 09:00–09:30 BST — dial-in + quick tech checklist
- Customer-facing demo (Kairos + CloudWave + Redwood): Wed Apr 17, 14:30–15:10 BST — 40 minutes

Attendees (tentative): Amrita Shah (Kairos), Ben Rosenberg (Orchestrate), CloudWave lead engineer (Lena or Arjun), Kimberly Park (Redwood), Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood), Karthik Iyer (Redwood).

Action items:
- Amrita: confirm which CloudWave engineer will attend and share the final Kairos preflight checklist (I need the file name to attach).
- Karthik: share the IP ranges and the pinned model name by EOD Monday so we can include them in the dry run notes.
- Vanessa: send invites with attachments and a short agenda (25/10/5 split).

I added the calendar link here so everyone has it: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-kairos-demo-0429
And I linked the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2345678

Attachments included on invite: Kairos-Preflight-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-Runbook-v2.pdf

If anything changes I’ll update the invites. Looking forward — want to make sure the marketplace flow in AWS is clean and that CloudWave has what they need to scope the SI work.

Kimberly Park
